title: Video Grabber
description: Detect and download videos from any website — streams, MP4s, and more. Free Chrome extension.
longDescription: Video Grabber is a free Chrome extension that automatically detects videos as they load on any page. Whether it's a news stream, sports broadcast, educational video, or social media clip, Video Grabber gives you one-click access to download it — in the best available resolution, with optional clip trimming, file renaming, and pause/resume support.
priceNote: Pay what you want, no subscription

whatsInside: Automatic video detection as content loads on any webpage

previewTips.label: Tip
previewTips.tip: Open the extension popup while a video is playing to see all detected sources instantly

previewTips.label: Pro tip
previewTips.tip: Use the clip feature to grab only the highlight you need instead of the full video

whoIsItFor: Content creators who need offline reference clips
Developers testing video playback across resolutions
Anyone archiving educational or sports content
Researchers saving media for offline review
